For the Greater Good
Change to:
‘If your Army Faction is T’AU EMPIRE, at the start of your Shooting
phase you can select units from your army with this ability to become
Observer units.
During your Shooting phase, for each Observer unit from your army
that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is eligible to shoot
(excluding FORTIFICATION and Battle-shocked units) select one enemy
unit that is visible to be marked as their Spotted unit until the end of
the phase. Each enemy unit can only be marked as a Spotted unit once
per phase.
Units from your army with the For the Greater Good ability (excluding
Observer units) are Guided units while targeting one or more
Spotted units.
Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your army in a
Guided unit makes an attack that targets a Spotted unit, improve the
Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1 and, if the Spotted unit
was marked by an Observer unit that has the Markerlight keyword, that
attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.’

checks.instructionHeading: STRATAGEMS THAT PREVENT UNITS FROM BEING TARGETED
STRATAGEMS THAT ADD NEW UNITS TO YOUR ARMY
requiredText: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

universalChecks.sourceScopeQualification: These three applicable instructions are already reflected in the current effective native fields; checks verify applicability and current values without changing them. The CP-cost instruction applies only when the rule does not specify the Stratagem name. Homing Beacon explicitly names the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP, so that named permission is retained and is not converted by the generic CP-cost amendment. No missing effect, eligibility or runtime behavior is inferred from these checks.
